anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="02:40">Hello everyone. This is [[Father Andrew]].</Dialogue>

<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="01:26:40">After I read that excerpt, we received a lot of positive feedback, as this was many people's first encounter with this amazing piece of writing that seems to have taken its present form in the fourth or fifth century.</Dialogue>

<Dialogue speaker="Carinus and Leucius" time="05:04:08">Now when we were set together with all our fathers in the deep, in obscurity of darkness, on a sudden there came a golden heat of the sun and a purple and royal light shining upon us, and immediately the father of the whole race of men, together with all the patriarchs and prophets rejoiced, saying,</Dialogue>

<Dialogue speaker="Seth" time="08:26:00">For thou wilt not be able to receive it save in the last days and times, save when five thousand and five hundred years are accomplished, then shall the most beloved Son of [[God]] come upon the earth to raise up the body of Adam, and the bodies of the dead, and he shall come and be baptized in Jordan. And when he is come forth of the water of Jordan, then shall he anoint with the oil of mercy all that believe on him. And that oil of mercy shall be unto all generations of them that shall be born of water and of the [[Holy Spirit]], unto life eternal.</Dialogue>

<Dialogue speaker="Narrator" time="03:21:30">And as [[Satan]] the prince and Hell spoke this together, suddenly there came a voice as of thunder and a spiritual cry, "Remove, O princes, your gates and be lift up ye everlasting doors and the King of glory shall come in."</Dialogue>
